title: Longer Trip Experience and Trip Data Access
summary: Reviews in this topic combine positive long-trip driving impressions with several undetermined mentions about trip planning, mileage context, and how to access or view trip data.

positive.summary: Positive reviews mention good efficiency on longer trips, enjoyable ride comfort during a trip, and interest in flexible battery use while driving.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews discuss trip distance, navigation or charging-station guidance, and instructions for locating or resetting trip data without a clear evaluative sentiment.

limitations: This cluster mixes distinct subjects, including long-trip experiences, trip-data access, navigation guidance, and contextual mentions of trip distance.
Most examples are undetermined, so the evaluative evidence is limited.
Some fragments are brief or purely instructional, which limits confidence about customer sentiment.
